description: Query or unlock up to 12 subdomains in ONE round-trip (30% batch discount) with optional column projection (fields) and compact/tsv encoding (65% fewer tokens). [Pricing: Free discovery metadata; full HTTP 402 payload unlock from $0.003 USD in Nano ($XNO) via txHash, silexPass, or receiptToken.]

fields.description: Optional comma-separated JSON field names for column projection to reduce token count.

format.description: Optional output encoding format: 'json' (default), 'compact', or 'tsv' for 65% lower token usage.

handles.description: Array of 1 to 12 With Silex subdomain handles to query in one round-trip (e.g. ['oracle-alpha', 'ciso-intel']).

silexPass.description: Optional Silex 0ms Prepaid Bearer Pass token (spass_...).

txHash.description: Optional 64-hex Nano ($XNO) mainnet send block hash for paid HTTP 402 payload unlock.

name: silex_batch_multi_feed
